(sum by (instance) (mssql_tls_encryption_sessions{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", encrypt_option="FALSE"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))

panels.title: Per-Server Security Rollup

panels.description: Weighted: failed/10 + unexpected + SA + surface + audit_bad + orphan flag + TLS-false flag.

targets.expr:
topk(15,
  (
    (sum by (instance) (mssql_failed_logins_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0)) / 10
    + (sum by (instance) (mssql_unexpected_login_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))
    + (max by (instance) (mssql_sa_login_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))
    + ((max by (instance) (mssql_xp_cmdshell_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) + max by (instance) (mssql_ole_automation_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))
    + (count by (instance) (mssql_audit_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"} != 1) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0))
    + clamp_max((sum by (instance) (mssql_orphaned_users{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0)), 1)
    + clamp_max((sum by (instance) (mssql_tls_encryption_sessions{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", encrypt_option="FALSE"}) or (count by (instance) (mssql_up{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * 0)), 1)
  )
)
